scope: Successor repair of active feedback starvation; not full G5 performance or release certification

normal_timing_pass.cold_setup: Complete initial canonical frame before Down; shader/resource setup and restoration recorded separately.
normal_timing_pass.input: Use fixed time schedule and record actual dispatch lateness; never await a display or GPU completion to admit the next Move.
forbidden_observer_work: GPU finish/fence waits added by sampler
adaptive easing, event dropping, geometry simplification or skipping difficult gestures
normal_timing_pass.content_definition: Normal pass observes actual default-framebuffer content writes and intervals,excluding RAF/offscreen/clear/masked calls. This is a publication-opportunity proxy only,not proof of fresh geometry. MP02+MP03 are accepted jointly with qualification prefix identity and separate active-content pixels; never claim raw normal draw counts alone prove freshness.
normal_timing_pass.steady_window: Each gesture from Down to Up, with start and end gaps included. No per-gesture hidden warmup or stationary catch-up counts as moving feedback.
normal_timing_pass.p95_role: Report SDK callback, input dispatch, publication intervals and tail age separately. 33.4ms is the existing phase target, not a newly claimed full SLO; this repair blocks on the 150ms no-starvation ceiling.
normal_timing_pass.invalid_run: If the sampler stalls input,mandatory observations are lost or context is unavailable,preserve raw and classify the terminal blocker. Never discard/resample a slow case. Normal counters are intentionally a proxy; do not invent a normal-only prefix API.
normal_timing_pass.tail_age_evaluation: Use qualification-only source-consumption/publication prefix identities on the identical fixed schedule; maximum pending sample lag9 at60Hz. Normal SDK gains no private API. Stationary held periods with no new input are evaluated separately.

active_content_pass.capture: Use the unchanged qualified WebGL readback/failure-copy helper in a distinct fixed-schedule correctness pass. Capture fixed active ROIs at planned 0.25, 0.5 and 0.75 gesture fractions; compare a prefix at least 150ms old and assert new erasure before Up. No wait-until-correct/exact polling.
active_content_pass.oracle: Pinned uncached reference rendering of the baseline snapshot with only that fixed gesture prefix and all earlier committed masks, using existing partialEraseGeometry and object order/opacity. Baseline/ROI/AA guards are fixed from inputs/reference, never candidate differences.
active_content_pass.rule: Require new erase coverage in each positive active ROI and preserve unaffected content. Match original pairwise2/interior plus independently fixed AA-boundary rules. Do not change old kernel, palette, AA policy or enlarge edge exclusions.
active_content_pass.final: Before/after/Undo/Redo full canonical/preview captures against the old reference and after/Redo equality; original R4 fixed-ROI preservation and matching receipt remain required.

native_progress_pass.red: Actual renderer receives at least 60 changing nonempty active prefixes, with per-call work budget unchanged; observe starvation under the old staged route, then hold the same prefix as a progress control.
native_progress_pass.force_staging: A private native test may lower maxEntries only to force the same bounded staged route when Metal completion is too fast. Label this as a structural regression, not default-budget Web evidence.
native_progress_pass.green: During changing demand, accepted display prefixes and actual changed target pixels advance repeatedly; prepared immutable body compile count does not scale with copies times frames; fixed-demand control still finishes. No stale semantic/surface publication.

proof_join: MP02 timing proxy,MP03 fixed active-content pixels and qualification immutable prefix identity are a conjunctive oracle. A fake repeated-old-frame writer may pass the normal interval subcheck but must fail the overall oracle. No hidden normal diagnostic export is permitted.
